title: Phi-4 joins the text model lineup
summary:
A small garden day: Phi-4 arrived in text, and two community projects got easier to find.

text.pollinations.ai now includes Microsoft's Phi-4, while Cloudflare-backed models have moved behind the Portkey router. More model choice, with the routing plumbing kept out of the way where it belongs.

The projects list now points to ComfyUI-Pollinations and a Chinese DeepSeek tutorial, making it easier to find both node-based image workflows and Chinese-language guidance for building with AI.
